$ aws-login 
--- stdout
==> aws sso logout (ends the current Identity Center session)
Successfully signed out of all SSO profiles.
==> aws sso login --profile planlab-prod
Successfully logged into Start URL: https://example.invalid/start
==> aws sts get-caller-identity --profile planlab-prod
--- stderr
aws-login: login reported success but 'planlab-prod' cannot get credentials; check the profile's account and role in ~/.aws/config
--- exit 1
--- aws calls
configure list-profiles
configure get sso_session --profile planlab-prod
sts get-caller-identity --profile planlab-prod --output text --query Arn
sso logout
sso login --profile planlab-prod
sts get-caller-identity --profile planlab-prod --output text --query Arn
--- stamps
